land.title: Land Verification & Due Diligence
land.description: Before you pay for a stand, we make sure it is real, properly pegged and legally clean. A qualified lawyer checks the title (included in the service). A council officer confirms the pegs on site. Our team measures the stand, records GPS coordinates and takes dated photos and video. You receive a written report with any red flags explained in plain words.

materials.title: Materials Procurement
materials.bullet2: Nothing is bought without your approval
materials.description: Tell us what your build needs and we gather quotes from suppliers, side by side. Nothing is bought until you approve it in writing. Every receipt is photographed and shared with you, and delivery is documented with photos.

monitoring.title: Site Visits & Construction Monitoring
monitoring.description: Regular visits to your site with dated photos, measurements and plain-word updates on progress — so you always know what is really happening.

camera.title: Live Site Camera (24/7)
camera.bullet1: Watch your build live from anywhere
camera.description: A solar-powered camera on your site, streaming live and recording to the cloud — so you can watch your build from anywhere and your materials are protected while builders are on site.

servicesPage.title: Our Services
servicesPage.intro: LBH is a service company — our own team in Zimbabwe does the work on your behalf. Every job starts with a free first call, followed by a written quote. No prices are shown publicly; your quote is personal to you.
servicesPage.notifyHint: This service is coming soon. Tap “Notify me” on your free call and we will let you know the moment it is live.

howPage.title: How it works
howPage.intro: One clear journey, from first call to finished report. You approve every step — nothing moves without you.
howPage.note: You pay for every trip we make on your behalf. If we make a mistake, we fix it at our own cost. No extra trip or extra cost ever happens without your approval in the portal.
howPage.stage1Text: 30–45 minutes, phone or video. You tell us about your land or your build. It costs nothing.
howPage.stage2Text: After the call you receive a written quote — the service fee and estimated travel, in plain figures. Only LBH sets prices; prices never appear on this website.
howPage.stage3Title: You accept and pay a 50% deposit
howPage.stage3Text: Accept the quote in your portal — your name and the time are recorded as written acceptance. You pay a 50% deposit by card, EcoCash and other methods, or tell us you paid by bank transfer or remittance.
howPage.stage4Text: Our own field team does the work — with dated, GPS-tagged photos and video. Field staff never see prices and never sign off their own work.
howPage.stage5Text: Every field report goes to LBH admin first. Admin reviews it and publishes it to you — nobody signs off their own work.
howPage.stage6Title: You get a full written report
howPage.stage6Text: A clear verdict at the top, findings in plain words, measurements, dated photos and every receipt. If travel cost less than estimated, you are credited.
howPage.stage7Text: Once the report is published, you pay the remaining 50%. Done — and we are ready for your next step.

aboutPage.title: About LBH
aboutPage.intro: LBH — Let's Build Home — helps Zimbabweans living abroad verify land, buy building materials and follow their build back home, without being there.
aboutPage.whoText: We are a Zimbabwe-based service company. We are not a marketplace and we do not sell land — our own team does the work on your behalf: a qualified lawyer for title checks, an architect/project manager, and trusted field agents on the ground.
aboutPage.whyText: Too many people in the diaspora have lost money to fake stands, missing materials and builds that never move. LBH exists so that your money never moves without your permission — and so you can see, in photos and reports, exactly what is happening on your land.
aboutPage.value1: Your money never moves without your permission.
aboutPage.value2: Nobody signs off their own work — every report is reviewed before you see it.
aboutPage.value3: Every receipt is photographed and shared.
aboutPage.value4: If we make a mistake, we fix it at our own cost.
aboutPage.teamText: A qualified lawyer (title and legal checks), an architect / project manager, and field agents across Zimbabwe. Full team profiles are coming soon.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These terms govern the services provided by LBH (Let's Build Home). Plain-English summaries appear first in each section; they are part of the terms.
termsPage.s1Title: 1. Who we are and what we do
termsPage.s1Text: LBH is a service company based in Zimbabwe, operated by [LBH ZIMBABWE ENTITY NAME · REG NUMBER]. We act on your written instructions: verifying land, procuring materials and monitoring construction on your behalf. We are not a marketplace, an estate agent, or a seller of land or materials.
termsPage.s2Text: Every job starts with a free first call, after which we send you a written quote. Work begins only after you accept the quote and pay a 50% deposit. The balance is due when your report is published. All amounts are in US dollars.
termsPage.s3Text: You pay for every trip we make on your behalf, as itemised in your quote. Travel is reconciled against receipts: if actual travel costs less than estimated, the difference is credited to you.
termsPage.s4Text: No extra trip, fine, council charge or any other extra cost will be incurred without your prior approval in the client portal. Work pauses until you approve or decline.
termsPage.s5Text: If LBH makes a mistake, LBH fixes it at its own cost. This does not cover issues caused by third parties, authorities, or information you provided that proves inaccurate.
termsPage.s6Text: A land verification report is a physical and documentary check carried out on a specific date. It is not a guarantee of title, value or future events, and it is not legal advice beyond the lawyer's findings stated in it.
termsPage.s7Text: LBH acts on the client's instructions. You are responsible for the accuracy of the instructions and documents you give us.
termsPage.s8Text: Questions about these terms: contact us by email or WhatsApp via the Contact page.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: LBH respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your rights. It is written to comply with Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] and, because most of our clients live abroad, the UK GDPR.
privacyPage.s1Text: Contact details (name, email, WhatsApp number, country), details about your land or build that you choose to share, documents you upload (such as title deeds and agreements of sale), payment records, and messages you send us.
privacyPage.s2Text: To provide the services you ask for: booking calls, preparing quotes, verifying land, procuring materials, reporting back to you, and processing payments. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for third-party advertising.
privacyPage.s3Text: Your data is stored with reputable cloud providers. Documents are kept in private storage, accessible only via time-limited signed links by you and authorised LBH staff.
privacyPage.s4Text: Only you and the LBH staff who need it for your job. Field staff see only the job details they need — never your prices, quotes or payments.
privacyPage.s5Text: You may request a copy of your data, correction of inaccurate data, or deletion of your account and data. Export and deletion tools are available in your portal settings, or contact us and we will do it for you.
privacyPage.s6Text: We keep records of completed jobs (including reports and payment records) as long as the law requires for tax and audit purposes, then delete them.
privacyPage.s7Text: For any privacy question or request, contact us by email or WhatsApp via the Contact page.
